difficulty_reason: The authors use iterated random restrictions with masked indices to make nondeterministic computations heuristically decidable while preserving hidden random functions against subexponential-size oracle adversaries. A random-oracle PRG and hitting-set chain then certifies errorless average-case hardness in the same world.
